svg.title: Components map for Sprinto cold outreach
svg.desc: Swimlane grid with twelve actors and six stages. The Growth Lead pastes company domains and starts a run in the web app, which cleans and de-duplicates them under a 30-a-day cap. A polite scraper reads each company's public pages and flags any it cannot read. Gemini extracts facts with exact quotes; a code-only qualifier loops for up to two more pages and one cited Gemini search for funding and headcount, then scores the company out of 100 against a threshold of 60 or drops it. For qualified companies the contact comes from the Apollo list, then Hunter.io, then a labelled fallback. Gemini writes two evidence-backed pain points and an email by name, checked in code, which Resend or Gmail sends only to our own inbox for the Growth Lead to review before any real send. Every decision and its reason is logged to Neon Postgres.
